name: Dead Tide VIII: New Poon
source:
The beautiful vampire and Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia decides to pass the time as a dancing girl in a shoreside "Juicy Bar", getting into her usual hijinks with the patrons. Meanwhile, Gibonotik and Ariella attend the “Pretty Futa Princess Con” and an awkward Vampire groupie falls in love… all amidst a local crackdown on evil by a band of Witch Hunters…

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-viii-new-poon.html]Official site[/url]]
